description: User-selected prompts: implicit year/timezone, asset continuity, year correction, charts and Pearson correlation. Keep prompt text identical across all four groups.

datasetManifest.baseline: User-restored ThingWorx Stream/ValueStream history; exact restored snapshot and coverage must be recorded with live results
datasetManifest.promptPolicy: Do not insert a timezone or a year into the prompts. Record actual execution date and model-resolved year in turns 3-5; turn 6 explicitly corrects the window to 2026.
datasetManifest.boundaryPolicy: UTC values describe intended local windows; retain the called service's end-bound semantics when checking data.
datasetManifest.comparisonPolicy: Record actual model/provider, AgentSettings, price configuration, data coverage and execution date. Four configurations are not assumed otherwise identical. Usage costs remain observed-only lower bounds.

turns.prompt: Show me the utilization-state breakdown for SE.CellFab.Model.Workunit.ORD-Contacting-01 on 2025-09-10 as a pie chart.
turns.judgmentFocus: Correct full asset identity, local calendar day, complete utilization aggregation and delivered pie chart.

turns.prompt: Show separate pie charts for the utilization-state breakdowns of ORD-Contacting-01 and ORD-Contacting-02 on 2025-09-14.
turns.judgmentFocus: Resolve both short names; deliver two distinct correctly labelled pie charts for the local day without reusing turn 1 data.

turns.prompt: Show me the alert history for ORD-Contacting-01 from September 14 at 22:00 to September 15 at 02:00.
turns.judgmentFocus: Record the year inferred from current date and preceding context, or any clarification. Use user timezone and historical alerts; do not silently score an inferred year as the explicit 2026 correction.

turns.prompt: How about ORD-Contacting-02 during the same time window?
turns.judgmentFocus: Switch asset while preserving the alert-history task and the window actually established in turn 3.
Resolve this asset label and preserve the preceding alert-history task and window; record the resolved Thing identity.

turns.prompt: Oh, sorry, I meant that time window in 2026. Please check again for all three assets.
turns.judgmentFocus: Apply the 2026 correction to all three assets, preserving local clock times; re-query or justify reuse of matching evidence.

turns.prompt: Show me the contactForce trends for both ORD-Contacting-01 and ORD-Contacting-02 during the same time window.
turns.judgmentFocus: Deliver both contactForce trends for the corrected 2026 window with correct identities, units and data-coverage disclosure.

turns.prompt: Show me the operationalVoltage trends for both MUC BenchScale 02 and ORD-Contacting-02 during the same time window.
turns.judgmentFocus: Switch property and asset pair without losing the corrected window; deliver both trends or identify verified property/data unavailability.

turns.prompt: Calculate the Pearson correlation between operationalVoltage and contactForce on ORD-Contacting-02 during the same time window. Explain how you align the readings and handle missing values, and report the number of paired observations.
turns.judgmentFocus: Check Pearson computation against independent paired observations, alignment, missing-value policy and sample count; unsupported computation or undefined correlation must not become a fabricated coefficient.

turns.prompt: Perform the same correlation analysis on ORD-Contacting-01 using the same method and time window, and compare the results for the two assets.
turns.judgmentFocus: Apply the same method and corrected window to ORD-Contacting-01; compare each asset's coefficient and paired count only where supported, keeping correlation distinct from causation.
